rule_review._source: Our reading of each product against CLAUDE.md section 2 (out of scope: significant safety risk, high return complexity) using the scouts' ip_safety_flags. Dhruv can overrule.

blocked.jump-starter-air-compressor: High-current lithium pack clamped to a car battery; certification UNKNOWN. The scout flagged it as a likely fail on safety.
blocked.dog-force-dryer: Mains-powered heated appliance used on animals; electrical certification UNKNOWN; over 10 lb.
blocked.towel-warmer-bucket: Mains-powered heating appliance; electrical certification UNKNOWN; over 9 lb.
blocked.cordless-heated-blanket: Battery-heated textile; certification UNKNOWN; no US stock found.
blocked.heated-gloves-7v: Blocked until battery certification is in hand: lithium packs and a heating element worn on the body, paperwork (UL, ETL or UN38.3) UNKNOWN. Its low cost is a listing with 3 sold.
blocked.heated-vest-powerbank-kit: Blocked until battery certification is in hand: heating element worn on the body; two sellers and two parcels.
blocked.heated-socks-app: Blocked until battery certification is in hand: lithium packs worn against the leg.
blocked.leg-air-compression-massager-heat: Medical rule: an air-compression leg massager is an FDA Class II device when sold for circulation or pain. The scout flagged it as likely excluded.
blocked.cordless-heated-hand-massager: Medical rule: air-compression massagers sold for pain or circulation are FDA Class II devices; lithium battery and heat.
blocked.shiatsu-foot-massager-machine: Mains-powered heated appliance, certification UNKNOWN; listings lean on health claims we cannot use.
blocked.cordless-neck-shoulder-kneading-massager: Blocked until battery certification is in hand: lithium battery and a heating element next to the neck.

caution.cordless-tire-inflator: Lithium battery with a motor; certification UNKNOWN; two giant brands.
caution.mattress-vacuum-uv: UV light: no germ-killing or health claims allowed without proof.
caution.japanese-style-knife-set: The $26.49 cost is a 15-piece block set with 12 sold, not the gift set the $99 price is based on. Meta's ad rules on bladed items do not clearly allow kitchen knives. Never call it Japanese-made unless it is.
caution.rechargeable-wall-sconce-pair: Amazon sells sets of 2 at $45 to $57 with Prime, about half our price. The cost is one listing with 12 sold.
caution.music-boxing-machine: Design patents exist for this product type; which factory shapes they cover is UNKNOWN.
caution.barkfare-extender-us-stock: Your approved Nov 18 fast lane. The listing has 9 sales and an unknown store; the price is our own proposed kit price.
caution.portable-carplay-screen-kit: CarPlay and Android Auto are trademarks: 'works with' wording only, no logos. Similar screens sell for $45 to $77 on Amazon.
